chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umeyr, from Murazam, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
The performer of the exclusive Umra cuts off the Talbiyya when the camel places its hooves in the Haram.

key_terms.أَخْفَافَهَا: Its hooves (referring to the camel's feet)
key_terms.الْحَرَمِ: The Sacred Precincts (specifically the boundary of Mecca)
key_terms.الْعُمْرَةِ الْمُفْرَدَةِ: Exclusive Umra (Umra performed alone, distinct from Tamattu or Qiran)

ai.seo_question: When does the performer of Umra Mufrad stop reciting Talbiyya?
ai.summary: This narration from al-Kafi highlights the precise moment a Mufrid terminates the Talbiyya upon entering the Haram, distinguishing it from the Qarīn who continues until reaching the Mataf. This ruling underscores the scholarly emphasis on the sanctity of the sacred precincts as the threshold for transitioning from the state of pilgrimage invocation to the specific rites of Umra.

en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Murazam, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘The performer of the exclusive Umra would cut off the Talbiyya when the camel places its hooves in the Harram’.
en.sarwar: 1. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from ibn abu ‘Umayr from Murazim who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said that
one who performs a separate al-‘Umrah should discontinue Talbiyah (here I am, O Lord, to obey Your command) as soon as the camel sets foot in al- Haram (the sacred area).”
